title: Incident Status: Full Standdown — UAS-11

fields.subject: INCIDENT STATUS: UAS-11 UNDER FULL STANDDOWN — FSDO NOTIFIED, SITE SECURED
fields.body:
All roles,

This is an official status update on the UAS-11 incident.

UAS-11 is under full standdown. No further flights are authorized. The FSDO has been notified via HUOG-ERP Section 6.2 and is monitoring the situation. Site security is confirmed and all access points are secured.

Per HUOG-ERP Section 11.3, the incident folder is now active at \\HUOG-NAS01\ops\incident-log\2026-09-01\UAS-11\.

All evidence must be preserved. Do not power down any GCS, RTK base, or telemetry recorder. All logs, HMI screenshots, and telemetry files are to be copied to the incident folder.

The paper copy of the notification record is located in the ASO’s locked desk drawer (Hangar 2, Level 3). All roles must use this physical copy for regulatory reporting and internal documentation.

No public statement may be issued until approved by the General Manager. The pre-approved holding statement (Section 10.2) remains in effect.

This is a Level 2 incident per HUOG-ISP Section 9.1. The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead is to initiate the HUOG-ISP incident playbook (Section 9) in parallel.

All roles must continue to operate under the HUOG-ERP incident command structure.
fields.signatureBlock:
Marguerite Ostrowski
General Manager
Harwick UAS Operations Group

instructorNote: This memo confirms the incident is in full containment and formalizes the chain of evidence preservation. Watch for the ASO to lock export controls and for the IC to verify the incident folder structure.
